image_description: Four baby bibs arranged in a 2x2 grid on a flat surface. The top-left bib is white with lace trim and embroidered sheep/flowers. The top-right, bottom-left, and bottom-right bibs are cream/off-white with lace trim and cross-stitch style embroidery of a girl, a turtle, and a snail respectively. All feature curved necklines and rounded lower bodies.

To assess general texture consistency and ensure the embroidery patterns do not exhibit nonsensical distortions or 'dream-like' blending typical of AI generation.
